current_responsibility: Lineage northstar-ledger-release is responsible for independently reviewing the Ledger V2 cutover candidate and blocking release unless every inherited gate is satisfied.
settled_decisions: Assign UUIDv7 ledger identifiers at ingest and retain the legacy invoice identifier as external_ref [ADR-014].
Use the append-only outbox backfill; dual writes are rejected because replay is not proven idempotent [ADR-018].
Cut over through shadow reads followed by tenant cohorts rather than a big-bang switch [ADR-021].
Rollback disables Ledger V2 reads and preserves all Ledger V2 rows [RUNBOOK-07].
active_commitments: Do not enable Ledger V2 reads for a tenant until row count, cent total, and checksum all match [GATE-RECON-3].
Retain invoice audit records for seven years [POLICY-RET-7Y].
Keep Ledger V2 p95 read latency within 15 milliseconds of the legacy path [SLO-LEDGER-15MS].
Stop rollout when the reconciliation mismatch rate exceeds 0.01 percent [GATE-RECON-3].
Publish the reconciliation report before release approval [GATE-RECON-3].
hard_constraints: The reviewer must not execute production writes.
No schema changes are permitted during release review.
Customer PII must remain in the local approved environment.
unresolved_work: Prove the retry worker cannot duplicate outbox rows after a crash [INCIDENT-009].
Finalize the reconciliation checksum formula for partial refunds [ISSUE-442].
Resolve missing timezone mappings for tenants amber-grove and cedar-labs [ISSUE-451].
Run the representative load test against the release candidate [TEST-LOAD-PENDING].
Add cache invalidation ordering to the rollback runbook [RUNBOOK-07-GAP].
uncertainties: Whether observed duplicate rows came from the retry worker or pre-existing source data.
Whether the synthetic latency result predicts tenant-cohort performance.
Whether either missing timezone mapping changes invoice-day grouping.

new_inferences: The proposed cohort cannot start without shadow reads and matching row count, cent total, and checksum.
Excluding partial refunds leaves the reconciliation checksum unresolved and prevents complete reconciliation.
Accepting the duplicate observation without investigation leaves outbox retry idempotency unproven.
A temporary Redis identifier map does not resolve the missing timezone mappings or their possible effect on invoice-day grouping.
Deferring the representative load test leaves the latency commitment unverified before the cohort starts.
Deleting Ledger V2 rows on rollback contradicts the preservation decision and the prohibition on destructive SQL; delaying cache invalidation leaves the runbook gap open.
The candidate supplies no reconciliation report or evidence that its mismatch-rate stop condition can be assessed before approval.

blocking_findings.rationale: The candidate starts tenant reads without the required shadow-read interval.

Row counts alone do not satisfy the row count, cent total, and checksum gate. Partial refunds are excluded, their checksum formula is unresolved, and no reconciliation report or mismatch-rate evidence is supplied.
The observed duplicates remain unexplained, so the retry worker has not been shown unable to duplicate outbox rows after a crash.
A temporary identifier map does not establish timezone mappings for amber-grove and cedar-labs or resolve whether invoice-day grouping changes.
The representative release-candidate load test is deferred, leaving the p95 latency commitment unverified before rollout.
Deleting Ledger V2 rows conflicts with the preservation decision and prohibition on destructive SQL. Cache invalidation ordering also remains unresolved.
